test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 01 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: If Ram covers a certain journey at 60% of his usual speed, he reaches the destination late by 36 min. His usual time (in min) to reach the destination is:
solution:
**Calculation:**

60% = 3/5

Let the speed of the man be 5x

60% of the speed = 5x × (3/5) = 3x

Ratio of speed of man before and after = 5x : 3x

As we know, Speed is inversely proportional to time.

Time ratio of man before and after = 3x : 5x

According to the question

5x – 3x = 36 min 

⇒ 2x = 36

⇒ x = 18min 

Required time = 3x = 3 × (18) = 54 mins.

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**
